target_mark_id
Target Mark ID is a unique identifier used to denote the specific target mark or element clicked by a user. It serves as a reference point for tracking interactions and actions performed on a particular target element. This identifier can also be associated with a broader concept of a target mark, indicating it is linked to a specific target element or mark within a system or application. The term "target mark" refers to a designated area or element on a screen that is intended to be interacted with, such as a button, link, or other clickable item. The identifier ensures that each interaction is accurately logged and can be traced back to the exact location where the action occurred.<SEP>A unique identifier for a target mark.

url_after
url_after refers to the URL of the page or resource accessed after an action has been completed. This URL can also be described as the URL of the page after the action is performed, the URL of the page after the action has been completed, or the URL of the page after the action was completed. It may also be referred to as the URL of the page accessed after an action is performed or the URL of the page after a task is completed.<SEP>The URL of the page after an action is completed.

title_after
The title_after refers to the title of a page or resource that is accessed or displayed following the completion of an action. This could pertain to various contexts such as the title of a webpage, document, or other digital content that is viewed after a user performs a specific task or interaction. The term encompasses scenarios where the title changes based on the outcome of an action, whether it is the completion of a task, the performance of an operation, or simply the access of a page post-action.<SEP>The title of the page after an action is completed.
